issues.title: Testing-2: the mutation sweep audits the scenarios (instrument, status classes, four audit findings)
capture: sid is bound via setCurrent then awaited — write-time identity races the live session
Auto-capture subscribes to `session.idle`, which opencode 2.x never emits — the feature has never run
capture: captureOnCompact is undocumented, and its cooldown state is per-setup
lock: the absent-strike deadline rethrow does not mean "absent this whole time"
